A class of '''starfighter''' was used by the [[Rhokai gang]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. They pursued the renegade [[Clone Force 99]] in a [[Theft of Ruby|space battle]] after the clones [[Thief|stole]] a [[lizard]] named [[Ruby (lizard)|Ruby]] from the Rhokai.<ref name="Battle Scars" />
